{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for QA orders
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}")

# Confirm they are all completed or refunded
print(f"Status distribution of QA orders: {qa_orders['status'].value_counts().to_dict()}")

# Check if any QA orders are in the 'refunded' status
print(f"QA orders with status 'refunded': {len(qa_orders[qa_orders['status'] == 'refunded'])}")"}
